full_prompt_en: A square oil painting in an old-master manner shows a young child resting at a rustic table with baskets of fruit against a deep brown interior background. The wall behind is nearly featureless, warming slightly toward the light on the right while the upper-left corner falls into dark shadow. The child sits centrally, shown from the waist upward. Curly brown hair peeks from beneath a large crumpled white cloth cap whose broad folds frame the head. The pale face looks outward with a quiet, slightly weary expression. One hand props the cheek and the other forearm lies across the table edge, creating a relaxed crossing of arms in the foreground. A soft muted gray-green jacket has full sleeves, and white ruffled cuffs and a white gathered shirt show at the wrists and neck. The cloth folds are broad and weighty, lit along their ridges and dark in the recesses. On the left side of the table, a woven basket holds small pale fruit and leafy clusters beside a warm orange fruit. At the lower right, a second shallow basket contains green and orange fruit and a loose spray of straw-like stems. A covered woven vessel sits behind it in the right middle ground. The tabletop is partly covered by a coarse pale cloth, its edge hanging into the lower-left corner. Light arrives gently from the upper left, giving the face and white cap the highest values, then fades across the hands, fabric, wicker, and fruit. The painting shows smooth flesh modeling alongside visible soft brushwork in cloth and still-life objects. There is no readable text. The overall composition is calm and closely balanced, with muted earth colors, a luminous central face, and quiet domestic detail emerging from shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典大师风格油画呈现一位年幼的孩子倚在质朴桌边，身旁摆着水果篮，后方是深棕色室内背景。墙面几乎没有特征，向右侧亮光处稍稍变暖，左上角则陷入暗影。孩子坐在中央，从腰部向上入画。卷曲棕发从一顶宽大的皱褶白布帽下露出，帽子的厚重褶皱围住头部。浅色面庞朝向观者，神情安静而略带倦意。一只手托着脸颊，另一侧前臂横放在桌沿，在前景形成松弛的双臂交叠。柔软的低饱和灰绿色外套有宽松袖子，手腕和颈部露出白色褶边袖口及聚褶衬衣。布料的褶皱宽大且有分量，凸起处受光，凹处变暗。桌子左侧，一个编织篮里装有浅色小果与带叶的果串，旁边有一枚暖橙色水果。右下方另一只浅篮装着绿色与橙色水果，并伸出一簇松散的草秆状枝茎。其后右侧中景放着一只带盖编织容器。桌面部分覆有粗糙的浅色布，布边垂向左下角。柔光从左上方进入，让面庞与白布帽成为最亮区域，然后沿手、衣料、篮编和水果逐渐衰减。画中肤色塑形平滑，布料与静物仍有可见的柔和笔触。没有可读文字。整体构图安静且紧密平衡，以低饱和泥土色、发亮的中央面庞及从阴影中浮现的家常细节组成。
style_prompt_en: The oil-paint treatment uses a warm, low-key interior darkness as a reservoir from which softly illuminated forms emerge. Earth browns, muted green-gray, cream, and restrained fruit-like orange create a compressed palette with a small light center. Skin is smoothly modeled by gradual value changes, while woven and folded materials retain visible brush texture and stronger edge breaks. Broad cloth planes carry subtle warm and cool shifts rather than decorative pattern. Directional light enters from one high side, picks out raised folds and rounded volumes, and falls away gently toward the frame edges. Dark backgrounds have depth despite minimal detail, because their tone varies softly around the lit forms. Foreground objects overlap at close range and give the shallow arrangement a tactile sense of weight. The composition is steady and intimate, prioritizing human scale, carefully balanced still-life accents, and a contemplative silence. The overall effect is naturalistic, tender, and quietly luminous.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画处理让温暖而低调的室内深色成为背景蓄水池，柔和受光的形体从中浮现。泥土棕、低饱和灰绿、乳白与克制的果橙色构成压缩配色，亮部集中在较小的中央区域。肤色通过渐进明度变化平滑塑形，编织物与褶皱材料则保留可见笔触和较强的边缘断续。宽阔布面以细微冷暖变化取代装饰图案。定向光从高处一侧进入，照亮凸起褶线与圆润体积，再柔和地衰减至画幅边缘。深色背景虽少细节却仍有纵深，因为明暗在受光形体周围轻缓变化。前景物体近距离相互遮叠，让浅空间具有可触的重量。构图稳定亲密，强调贴近人的尺度、谨慎平衡的静物重音与沉思般的寂静。整体效果自然、温柔而安静发光。
theme_en: A thoughtful child at a rustic table with baskets of fruit
theme_zh: 一位若有所思的孩子坐在摆有水果篮的质朴桌边
name: Michael Sweerts
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
